label: Dapr: actor demo
info: Two generic actor types, each backed by a single JSON `record`. Actor hosting needs a Dapr Placement service and an actor-flagged state store (metadata actorStateStore: "true") -- see docs/deployment.md and redis-actorstore-component.yaml. Set the connection node's Dapr host/port and app port before deploying. Click the caller-side Inject nodes in order (SetMyData before GetMyData, ClearMyData after GetMyData to see it return null again, count/countBy before getCounter) and watch the debug sidebar. The reminder Inject nodes additionally need a Dapr Scheduler service -- see "Run the actor example" in examples/README.md; firing one wakes the reminder-trigger method node even if DemoActor has gone idle.

name: An actor is one object with its own saved state, addressed by an actor type and an ID
info:
Dapr runs calls to the same actor one at a time; calls to different actors run concurrently.

This example has two actor types, each modelled on one of Dapr's own SDK samples and each persisting its state as this package's single `record` per actor:

- `DemoActor` (GetMyData / SetMyData / ClearMyData) mirrors dapr/python-sdk's demo_actor.py: https://github.com/dapr/python-sdk/blob/c44c28d83f0648052094af6e7dfaa5a362fcf118/examples/demo_actor/demo_actor/demo_actor.py -- SetMyData copies the given object and adds a `ts` timestamp, the way the sample does. ClearMyData adapts the sample's `clear_my_data`: it sets `msg.dapr.actor.deleteState = true`, which deletes the actor's entire record. Because this package stores one record per actor, deleting it also clears the reminder-trigger method's own `lastReminder` bookkeeping below -- To remove selected fields instead, propose nextState with those fields omitted. The same sample's `set_reminder`/`receive_reminder` are also adapted: a `dapr-actor-schedule` node sets/deletes `demo_reminder`, and one `dapr-actor-method` node with Trigger set to Reminder receives every reminder DemoActor gets, recording the last one into the record. Upstream timers remain unsupported by this package.
- `DemoActorCounter` (count / countBy / getCounter) mirrors dapr/js-sdk's DemoActorCounterImpl.ts: https://github.com/dapr/js-sdk/blob/2395a2103cb3e7474e628012189867bfe836ac78/test/actor/DemoActorCounterImpl.ts -- the sample keeps its counter in memory; this example persists `{ counter }` in the actor's record instead, so the count survives a restart.

Adapted from the Dapr Authors' Apache-2.0 samples. See examples/DAPR-SAMPLES.md and examples/LICENSE-DAPR-2.0.txt. Unlike the JavaScript SDK sample, count/countBy return the new count and countBy accepts one JSON object argument.

name: GetMyData: return stored data
SetMyData: store with timestamp
ClearMyData: clear stored data
count: increment by one
countBy: increment by amount*multiplier
getCounter: return stored counter
reminder: record last reminder
Catch: safe error
ClearMyData (deletes the whole record; click GetMyData after to see null)
countBy: invalid amount (expect a caller error)
set one-shot reminder: demo_reminder_once at an RFC 3339 time (fires promptly once that time is past)
